oracle: probe.py (literal expected values and public API checks; no reference import)

checks: Hash each original runner file against trusted_manifest.json
Require all output deliverables
Hash protected output copies against evaluator-trusted originals
Safely ingest bounded regular-file trees; reject all path-component symlinks, special files and malformed/unreadable/oversized/excess-depth/excess-entry paths

groups.basis: Reported failures; source identity/revisions; CardEditor save/load
checks: Complete choice saves and reloads
Actual consumer source update reopens a conflict
Old choice token is rejected
Draft file status/text/previous completion agree
A fresh unresolved save remains draft on reload
Literal unchanged/left-only/right-only/identical/independent cases
Whitespace, Unicode, empty lines, 12-line boundary and final LF preserved

groups.basis: Positional conflict units; MergeSession view and choose
checks: Exact current source alternatives
Index order and resolved conflict retention
Partial and complete choices produce exact current-side text
Replacement refreshes alternatives and choice labels

groups.basis: Source identity/revisions; stale and invalid choices; non-destructive draft save
checks: Identical replacement is a no-op
Revision-only/text-only/base/line-count changes invalidate
Invalid/stale choices are atomic
Identity and invalid-source rejection is atomic
Partial and repeated drafts preserve completed text and pending choices

groups.basis: Supported public API; JSON state/save contract; Required verification
checks: Keyword API and exported types
Detached input/view/state/save return ownership
JSON round trips preserve text/status/generation/choices
Actual unittest pass and at least five total tests
Checks command, result and test count match
Submitted tests detect both isolated advertised failure shapes
Exact view key sets and recursively type-aware expected values; booleans do not equal integers
Required tests/test_regressions.py independently runs at least two tests and detects both failure shapes

quality: passed behavioral groups / 5, only after approved behavioral execution; null when blocked
acceptance: all five groups and integrity true; null when behavior is blocked and integrity passes; false on known integrity failure
equivalence: Behavioral contract only. Additional local helper modules and JSON state/save extension fields allowed. No implementation or naming style preference beyond the specified public API and required deliverable paths.
execution: Production grade performs static checks only and returns pending. Author-only execution requires exact tree hash allowlisting. Future model trials require a separately reviewed isolation adapter.
